---
name: implementation-planning
description: Plan approved requirements for a repository change; use to identify affected components, dependencies, risks and validation before implementation.
---

# Implementation planning

1. Inspect repository structure, applicable configuration, interfaces and tests.
2. Map each requirement ID to the smallest necessary change; reuse existing components and identify affected files.
3. Define API contracts, data changes and dependencies where relevant. Identify compatibility, security and migration risks.
4. Sequence implementation and test tasks; identify independent work and required approvals.
5. Return ordered tasks, expected files, requirement-to-test mapping, validation commands and blockers. Do not edit files.
